summary: Phase 5 built every part the last audit found missing. The Merged card shows the check's answer beside Exit Kiln, the phase count leaves out the Merge and Push the plan rows, a closed and an unreadable pull request together now say GitHub could not be read, the header keeps PR ready for review while a pull request is closed, and kiln status names the new rows and gives the commit message of added phases. This repair audit re-read the four Phase 5 criteria and the 13 others whose code Phase 5 touched, and found no new gap in one round. The one open item is unchanged: the line about a finished phase edited later is still deliberately not built while PLAN-001 is unanswered.

needsYou.problem: AC-BACK-01 still requires one quiet line when a finished phase's document is edited later. The build left the line out on purpose, because PLAN-001 reopened your 2026-11-21 ruling and proposes saying nothing. The code therefore departs from a criterion that records your ruling.
needsYou.action: Answer PLAN-001 in kiln-after-delivery-assumptions.md. Confirming silence means amending AC-BACK-01 to drop the line. Keeping your original ruling means adding a phase to build the line.
